chat-answer-with-claims.alt: A help desk agent's answer in the Grounded chat: numbered steps for resetting a password, each with a citation chip, an open claim card reading "Claim supported by this source" above the passage it came from, and a "5 of 6 claims supported" summary above the sources.
chat-answer-with-claims.caption: An answer with numbered citations. With SystemOne citation checks on, each claim shows its verdict.

agent-build.alt: The agent editor's Build tab: the agent's instructions, its model, knowledge bases and tools, and a Try it panel with an answer that used a tool
agent-build.caption: The agent editor: build a draft, try it, then publish an immutable version.

evaluations-runs.alt: An evaluation set's runs, with each run's score over time and the questions that failed
evaluations-runs.caption: An evaluation set: scores over time and what changed between runs.

team-overview-quality-and-spend.alt: A help desk team's Overview in Grounded: counts of data sources, knowledge bases, agents and documents; evaluation scores, with one set down 17 points from the run before; and this month's spend of $0.02 of a $50.00 budget.
team-overview-quality-and-spend.caption: The team Overview: each evaluation set's latest score and trend, and spend against the budget for owners and admins.

admin-overview-features.alt: The platform admin Overview with Needs attention and its Features card, listing the state of evaluations, the MCP server, OAuth sign-in for MCP clients (experimental), cost tracking, OCR, SSO groups, SystemOne, public access and maintenance
admin-overview-features.caption: Admin Overview: every optional feature's state, and where to set it.

costs-overview.alt: Admin Costs overview: spend, tokens, requests and unpriced usage, and a daily spend chart by kind, including MCP tools
costs-overview.caption: Costs: spend per team, agent and model, with monthly budgets.

admin-parsing-ocr.alt: Admin Parsing and OCR settings, choosing an OCR backend and testing it
admin-parsing-ocr.caption: Parsing & OCR: one backend, bounded per document, per worker and per team.

admin-sso-groups.alt: Admin SSO groups: rules that map identity-provider groups to team roles, with a dry run
admin-sso-groups.caption: SSO groups: map identity-provider groups to team roles, with a dry run first.

agent-share.alt: An agent's Share tab: audience, the public page, the embeddable widget snippet and the OpenAI-compatible model name
agent-share.caption: Share an agent in the web UI, as an embedded widget, or through the OpenAI-compatible API.

mcp-tool-source.alt: A Grounded chat answer about connecting to eduroam that cites a tool's result: among the sources, "From Service status · check_outage" appears next to passages from a Wi-Fi help article.
mcp-tool-source.caption: Agents can call tools that admins approved. A tool's result is cited like a passage, so claim checks cover it too.

health-connections.alt: Admin Connections with a Health column: three connections "Healthy" a few minutes ago and a backup gateway "Failing · since 8 minutes ago", with a Health filter.
health-connections.caption: Stored health: the last test of every connection, model and MCP server, re-tested on a schedule.

tracing-trace.alt: One Grounded answer as a trace in Jaeger: the HTTP request, the answer, retrieval, two model calls, an MCP tool call with its HTTP exchanges, and SystemOne checks, each with its duration.
tracing-trace.caption: One answer, one trace: retrieval, model calls, checks and tool calls.
